title: Smith-Waterman local alignment — align_sw
text: Local alignment affine gap penalties {match, mismatch, gap_open, gap_extend}. Penalties positive subtracted. pair score == 0 positive-scoring local alignment (disjoint sequences); four coordinates -1 cigar empty.

title: Smith-Waterman local alignment — align_sw
text: text Character vector; row-axis sequences (recycled). pattern Character vector; column-axis sequences (recycled). scoring Numeric vector length 4, named positional: (match, mismatch, gap_open, gap_extend). Recycled single vector given. defaults example, recommendation. with_cigar Logical; FALSE, score end coordinates computed (start coordinates cigar NA/-1).

title: Smith-Waterman local alignment — align_sw
text: data.frame one row per pair columns: score, start_i, start_j, end_i, end_j (0-based coordinates aligned span, -1 score 0/unknown), cigar (span), rescore_ok, wellformed_ok too_large (pair's matrix exceeded supported size limit).
